key_decisions.decision: Keeps unspecified plural slaughterers unassigned and identifies understood priestly blood agent, using splash distinct from sprinkle.
Retains full repeated anatomy and provisional liver-lobe interpretation consistent across offerings.
Keeps shared ownership rule while not collapsing distinct offering categories or interior-blood exception.
Preserves oil/dry alternatives and equal sharing among sons, without silently harmonizing it with the individual share in verse 9.
Preserves thanksgiving motive and all three unleavened preparation descriptions with distinct oil treatments; rare mixed term noted.
Retains additional leavened bread rather than mechanically importing chapter 2’s altar prohibition to all gifts.
Preserves same-day eating and explicit overnight prohibition, distinct from vow/freewill allowance.
Keeps two alternative motives and two-day consumption window.
Preserves acceptance/credit distinctions, defiled status and eater liability without resolving the rule into a later intent-based interpretation.
Keeps contact-based meat restriction and clean eater permission, with other supplied to clarify contrast.
Preserves uncleanness condition, divine ownership and cut-off sanction without defining its mechanism as mere exclusion.
Retains all three impurity categories and compound condition before repeated sanction.
Keeps carcass/torn-animal alternatives, permission for nonfood uses and emphatic eating ban.
Preserves sacrificial-kind scope and cut-off consequence without restricting only to fat already on the altar.
Keeps all-dwellings scope and both bird and land-animal blood, not reducing to mammal sacrifices.
Retains full emphatic blood prohibition and repeated sanction as independent closure.
Retains personal hands, fat/breast distinction and presentation rite, using the wave-offering terminology of Exodus 29 with uncertain motion noted.
Preserves divine first-person assignment, distinct presentation terms, named priestly family and repeated Israelite source.
Reads mishhah as allotted share connected with anointing, preserving priestly installation occasion and divine service.
Retains command, Israelite donors, anointing day and enduring generation scope without naming unexpressed anointer.
